user.title: BRUH Claude
user.description:
Connect to the BRUH Claude Terminal app. Make sure the app is installed and running before continuing.

Choose which features to enable for this entry.

data_description.name: A name for this entry (e.g. 'BRUH Claude'). Used as the agent name in Settings > Voice Assistants if conversation is enabled.
data_description.enable_conversation: Create a conversation agent you can use with voice assistants and the chat UI.
data_description.enable_sensors: Create sensors that track your Anthropic account usage limits (session and weekly).

data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: Optional system prompt that defines this agent's personality. Leave blank for the default assistant behavior.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

hassio_confirm.title: BRUH Claude Discovered
hassio_confirm.description:
The BRUH Claude Terminal app has been detected. Do you want to set up the BRUH Claude integration?

This will create a conversation agent and usage limit sensors. You can adjust features later in the integration options.

error.addon_not_running: The BRUH Claude Terminal app does not appear to be running. Start the app and try again.
error.no_features: Please enable at least one feature (conversation agent or sensors).
